title: Stickman Kit — Sống Đáng Tiền + Chú mèo học…
style: A4 Cozy Storytelling: flat 2D stick figures on detailed full-color cartoon backgrounds, gentle light, warm watercolor

global_rules.figure_construction: white filled circular head, two small dark oval eyes, simple eyebrow strokes, short curved mouth, closed white torso with solid white fill inside dark outline (slim for youth, slightly overweight for middle-aged), dark single-line limbs with constant medium weight, small dark rounded paws/hands
global_rules.drawing_rule: flat 2D stick figures on warm watercolor cartoon backgrounds, clear cartoon contours, shot-specific lighting, consistent line weights, no sketchbook borders, no 3D elements
forbid: readable text, letters, or numbers in frames
license plate numbers (must always be blank white plates)
cluttered modern digital gadgets unless explicitly specified
crude hand drawings or rough paper overlays
